acceptance.expected: 0 fail on the branch (focused coverage may exit nonzero). A real server on 127.0.0.1:0 receives raw GET targets //[, //%zz and //[/healthz: each answers 400 with exactly {"error":"invalid request target"}, JSON content type and all four SECURITY_HEADERS including nosniff and the independent contract wire version. tasks.title: Share a bounded admin auth throttle and prove the complete security fix
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, Behavior R3 and metrics, throttle documentation, throttle Checks, all whole-change Checks and Completion evidence; Required behavior R3 with revised R4, Performance impact, Security impact, Acceptance evidence and all throttle Counterexamples. Pin kit's merged full main SHA and refresh bun.lock with bun install. Keep the limiter policy, auth decision, recording, Retry-After, metric and suppressed warning together; synchronously check -> adminAccess -> record with one startup instance shared by both auth sites and defaults for standalone factories. R2's short denial counts too. Document routing to overflow while full OR overflow is live, including clients whose own window just ended, and the bound 200020 evaluated failures per 60000 ms per process (factor 2), never 100010. Isolate existing multi-denial tests with independent server/limiter state or fake-time windows, never a production throttle bypass. Capture the eleventh-request regression red on main c9e23af16e95494311cdbc8cc57f1f94c75b3af7. T1 and T2 evidence plus this regression form the three red/green findings. Deploy owns compose-e2e against the merged candidate under ## Repository: deploy; api retains CI, Bench, image, bun start and security evidence here.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail (focused coverage may exit nonzero). Policy is limit 10, window 60000 ms from the first failure, capacity 10000 clients plus one overflow budget. Failures 1..10 retain 401/403; subsequent attempts get 429 until exactly t0+60000 unless R4 routes the client into live overflow. Retry-After rounds up and stays 1..60, including backwards time; blocked attempts do not extend the window. Success does not reset; every denial kind including short and scope shares the budget; independent peers do not. At 10 failures plus 3 blocked requests the failure metric is 10 and the throttle metric is 3, with no throttle series before blocking. Warn admin auth throttled logs once per route per 60000 ms with the suppressed count and no client/credential data.

0 fail on the branch (focused coverage may exit nonzero). Real HTTP with fake now proves 10 failures followed by 429 {"error":"too many requests"}, Retry-After and security headers, no WWW-Authenticate, and no-store on token/audit routes. Budgets are shared across config, tokens, audit and manual writes, reconnects and spoofed forwarding headers. A valid blocked credential has no authenticate/lastUsedAt change; a blocked write reads no body and changes no revision or audit. 50 concurrent wrong-token requests give exactly 10 x 401 and 40 x 429. Public/ops/probe/heartbeat routes and feature-off/method/id/unknown-route answers before auth are unchanged. HTTP metrics record 429; captured logs and metrics expose no client address, raw path, header, secret, digest or secret length. Baseline returns 401 on request 11, failing the regression.

exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage; the lockfile resolves the full merged kit SHA named in the PR. All T1/T2 regressions remain green and no existing denial matrix exhausts shared test state accidentally.
exit 0; all benchmark harness selftests pass.
